description: Check whether a purchase paid in cuotas (installments) fits the user's future commitments. Returns the cuota, total cost, interest and effective annual rate, a verdict (FITS_ALL, FITS_TYPICAL_ONLY, BREACHES_ALL or BASELINE_BREACH) and up to three deterministic alternatives that fit. If the user does not say when the first cuota is billed, omit first_installment_month and the next month is assumed (and flagged). If no rate is given, a default monthly rate is assumed and flagged.

amount.description: Price in minor units of the user's currency.

installments.description: Number of cuotas; 1 means paid in one charge (no cuotas).

monthly_rate.description: Monthly interest rate as a fraction, e.g. 0.025.
